fix: src/render/stage.js. The gather takes CoC from the opaque depth buffer only, and the sprite pass is depthWrite:false, so every droplet inherits the depth of whatever is behind it -- void -> CoC 0. Give the sprites their own CoC channel and take cocEff = max(opaqueCoC, particleCoC): add one half-res R16F target that the transparent pass writes with min view-z (blend equation MIN, one extra target on the existing MRT, no new program), and OR it into pass 1's dilation exactly as the opaque CoC is used. Also publish `api.cocForZ(viewZ)` from the same solve so the sprite material can widen its own point size and soften its alpha kernel rather than being smeared by the post gather -- an additive sprite blurred after compositing loses its core, blurred at emission it does not. Validation on the shipped 00-hero.png, not a rig: bin the >40-lum droplet blobs by apparent diameter and require median 10-90 edge to rise monotonically past 6 px in the 18-26 px bin while the melon stays under 1.6 px in the same frame (today: 1.74 vs 1.55). And re-measure |lap| p99 inside the defocused apple in 09-combo: it must fall below plate-02's in-focus lemon, i.e. under 46 (today 54.7). Separately, put the exposure back: the key at 3.40 costs 24 counts of melon body median against plate-01 and the materials author has not taken up the headroom -- either restore ~0.35 stop or hold the contract and make it materials' blocking dependency, but do not ship another round at hero mean lum 15.8 against the plate's 67.2.
